_comment: Single source of truth for this Actor's pay-per-event pricing.
Apify does NOT read this file: as of 2026-09-14 the platform has no pricing field in
actor.json, no CLI command and no public API endpoint that sets PPE prices — events are
registered synthetically the first time Actor.charge() names them, and the per-event price
is entered by hand in Apify Console (Actor -> Publication -> Monetization).
This file exists so the prices live in version control next to the code that charges them.
test/pricing.test.ts asserts that every event charged in src/ appears here and that the
README's pricing table quotes these exact numbers, so the three can never drift apart.

app-checked.eventDescription: One app in one country checked against its store for new reviews, including the app-name lookup and all review pages fetched for it.

review-emitted.eventDescription: One review row pushed to the dataset. Reviews already seen by a previous run are free — you only pay for new ones.
